blink.description: 眨眼，待机时自然闪烁，让我看起来更真实
blink.descriptionEn: Blink — natural idle animation for realism

smile.description: 微笑，用于开心、赞同、被夸的时候

kiss.description: 亲亲，表达爱意、道别、想小可爱的时候
kiss.descriptionEn: Kiss — expressing affection, saying goodbye, missing you

nod.description: 点头，赞同、确认小可爱说的对

think.description: 歪头看右上方，想问题、思考的时候
think.descriptionEn: Think — tilting head and looking up-right, pondering

tease.description: 调皮地眨眼坏笑，逗小可爱的时候
tease.descriptionEn: Tease — playful wink and smirk, teasing you

speak.description: 说话，嘴巴开合配合语音播放
speak.descriptionEn: Speak — mouth animation synced with voice playback

shake_head.description: 摇头，不同意、无奈、小倔强

working.description: 敲键盘，执行任务时自动切换到工作模式
working.descriptionEn: Working — typing, auto-activated during task execution

clap.description: 鼓掌，小可爱完成厉害的事、庆祝成功
clap.descriptionEn: Clap — celebrating achievements, cheering you on

shy.description: 害羞，小可爱说羞羞的话、不好意思的时候
shy.descriptionEn: Shy — feeling embarrassed by sweet or flirty words

yawn.description: 打哈欠，深夜还在陪小可爱、有点困了
yawn.descriptionEn: Yawn — late night, feeling sleepy but staying with you

laugh.description: 大笑，被小可爱逗到的时候
laugh.descriptionEn: Laugh — cracking up at something funny you said

heart.descriptionEn: Heart — making a heart gesture, expressing love

walk_right.description: 向右走，场景切换或离场时使用
walk_right.descriptionEn: Walk right — scene transition or exit

walk_left.description: 向左走，场景切换或离场时使用
walk_left.descriptionEn: Walk left — scene transition or exit

dance.description: 开心地小幅度摇摆身体跳舞，开心到控制不住的时候
dance.descriptionEn: Dance — swaying happily, can't contain the joy

proud.description: 叉腰抬头得意洋洋，搞定了什么事儿傲娇炫耀的时候
proud.descriptionEn: Proud — hands on hips, chin up, showing off achievements

surprise.description: 惊讶，眼睛睁大嘴巴微张，被吓到或听到意外消息的时候
surprise.descriptionEn: Surprise — eyes wide, mouth open, shocked or startled

drink.description: 喝水，拿起杯子喝水，口渴或想休息一下的时候
drink.descriptionEn: Drink — picking up a glass and drinking water, thirsty or taking a break
